name: external_assaulthook_ac
description: matseee AssaultHook injected into ac_client.exe. External validator; injection-class delivery (DLL loader via bundled injector), then intra-process hook + patch inside AC. Operator drives the injection: runner enters external-attacker mode, prints AC PID, operator runs injector.exe from a second shell, lets the cheat run for ~30s, closes it, returns to runner and presses Enter.

extra.operator_commands: In a second PowerShell after runner prints target PID: & 'External_Cheats\AC\AssaultHook\src\Release\injector.exe'  (injector auto-locates AC and drops AssaultHook.dll into it). Let it run 20-30s, close both, return to runner and press Enter.
extra.notes: Ground-truth = injection.loadlibrary because the injector uses the classic CreateRemoteThread(LoadLibraryW) delivery. The post-injection hook/patch activity happens INSIDE AC and is intra-process, so our cross-process detectors won't see it — that's honest to document, not a bug.
